ValidationRule.description: Decided By and Decided On are set only by the stamp flow, in the same save as the decision.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED(Decided_By__c), ISCHANGED(Decided_On__c) ), NOT(ISCHANGED(Decision__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Decided By and Decided On are recorded automatically and can't be edited.
